cause: Duration rules were reimplemented at individual call sites with implicit conversion or unchecked datetime addition, some validation occurred after mutable path setup, and reaper audit queues were drained only after normal sweep completion.
prevention: Use one portable strict duration authority for plain-integer minima, bounded expiration, and overflow-safe grace comparison; validate before locks or stores; drain completed reaper audits from finally; retain exact RED boundary regressions across every caller.
summary: Task claim creation, low-level lease renewal, reaper grace, and watchdog admission accepted invalid or overflowing durations; deadline overflow could also strand an already-mutated reap without its queued audit.
title: Bind duration domains before claim authority mutation
